lore: A block of metal that has not yet become a pot.
use: The crucible while it is being built: each strike on the blank adds a stage (base, four walls, handle) and cracks it further. The last strike turns it into an Iron Crucible.
secret: It is the block you see halfway through building a crucible in the world. It has no recipe of its own.

lore: A pot of iron that cooks without a fire of its own.
use: A cooking station without fuel: every slot cooks at once, heated by the block below or two blocks below. 6 slots, speed 1x.
secret: Build it in the world: an axe in the main hand, iron ingots in the off hand, sixteen strikes on an iron block - side plates, handles, rim, one ingot each. Walk into it like a cauldron.

lore: A pot that learned to take twice the load.
use: The Reinforced tier of the crucible: 12 slots (2x6), speed 2x. An iron crucible becomes this in twelve axe strikes, one cracked diamond (or diamond) every third strike (the sledgehammer with SimpleBuilding).
secret: Contents, progress and experience stay when you upgrade in place.

lore: A pot that cooks at the speed of a Nether fire.
use: The Netherite tier of the crucible: 18 slots, speed 4x, experience is counted twice. A reinforced crucible becomes this in twelve strikes, one netherite nugget (or netherite scrap) every third strike.
secret: Lava or soul lava underneath makes it cook furnace and blast furnace recipes, and soul lava also ancient debris.

lore: A barrel clad in copper, a little greener each year.
use: The copper tier of the crucible barrel: it attaches to a crucible as extra storage, and works as a normal barrel on its own.
secret: It is the first step of the barrel line, from copper through netherite to enderite.

lore: A barrel that has been told to hold more.
use: The Reinforced tier of the crucible barrel: attach it to a crucible for more storage.
secret: Hoppers fill it like a chest, from above and the sides.

lore: A barrel of dark metal that does not burn.
use: The Netherite tier of the crucible barrel: attach it to a crucible for even more storage.
secret: It is fire resistant, like all Netherite blocks.

lore: A cauldron reinforced against its own contents.
use: Works like a vanilla cauldron (buckets, bottles, washing, rain, snow, dripstone) and holds lava and powder snow. With SimpleBuilding it also holds soul lava. Lava underneath a crucible heats it.
secret: Make it with an axe and 8 diamonds in the off hand, five uses on a cauldron. With SimpleBuilding the sledgehammer and cracked diamonds replace them.
